scripts.install:all: npm --prefix a install && npm --prefix b install && npm --prefix c install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n A,B,C,AUTH,MEMBER,WIDGET -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,gray "npm --prefix a run dev" "npm --prefix b run dev" "npm --prefix c run dev" "npm --prefix auth-api run dev" "npm --prefix member-api run dev" "npm --prefix c run widget:watch"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix a run build && npm --prefix b run build && npm --prefix c run build
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n A,B,C,AUTH,MEMBER -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix a run start" "npm --prefix b run start" "npm --prefix c run start" "npm --prefix auth-api run start" "npm --prefix member-api run start"
